title: Package Count per Shipment on Tailwise Autoship Pharmacy Subscriptions
content:
**Pharmacy care desk — package count on a prescription Autoship**

This rule sets the package count per shipment of an Autoship Pharmacy or Autoship Compounded Pharmacy subscription under Tailwise Autoship, written as the subscription's quantity, whenever that count is re-set under the prescription the subscription is linked to.

Once a renewed prescription has been linked to a pharmacy Autoship, the package count of that subscription is due to be re-set under the renewed prescription, whether or not the customer raises it.

The package count is a change to an existing subscription and sits within the Tailwise Autoship change rules for that subscription.

## Effect of the re-set

The subscription's packages per shipment become the count set. Every shipment processed from then on carries that many packages of the linked prescription; the item, the delivery frequency, the next ship date and the linked prescription stay unchanged. The customer sees the new package count on the subscription right away.

## Recording the count: `set_rx_shipment_packages_d23afb64`

**Capability.** Sets how many packages each shipment of one existing prescription Autoship (Autoship Pharmacy or Autoship Compounded Pharmacy) carries. The care agent performs it.

**How it is invoked.** The tool is held back from the open tool list: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it through `call_agent_discoverable_tool` under the name `set_rx_shipment_packages_d23afb64`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `autoship_id` | The reference number of the prescription Autoship subscription whose package count is set, as the customer's Autoship subscriptions lookup shows it | Id |
| `quantity` | The packages each shipment carries from now on | Integer, whole packages, no decimals |

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with three fields: `autoship_id` (the subscription reference number that was updated), `quantity` (the packages per shipment now on the subscription) and `status`, which is always `updated` when the change was saved. A status of `updated` is the success receipt.

### Illustration of a receipt (hypothetical values)

Called with a subscription reference number and a `quantity` of 2, the tool returns that reference number, a `quantity` of 2 and a `status` of `updated`.
